posts.name: Misfit
posts.cooked:
“Jarvis how do I buff warriors? What do you mean I should buff demon hunters and nerf warriors? Well I can’t code anyway might as well do what you say.”

It does feel like we are in a game where they just prompt an AI for the state of classes and do not even bother to do any research. We are in the halfway patch and balancing is nowhere near good enough and by the time it may be in an ok spot we will be in 12.1 and have to start over again. At least my ret pally has been safe from being blasted.

Every time something new is implemented it never works right and takes weeks to fix, if it ever gets fixed at all. Pretty sure they just fly off copilot and hope nothing breaks.

Alright back to purple parsing raid and still doing half the damage of a devourer demon hunter!
